hypothesis: The 531-CSF full single-core-hole/pair frontier on stationary bare005 orbitals can have a genuine mixed-CI EOL orbital gradient. An analytic constrained gradient confirmed by independently re-solved trial CI energies, followed by one accepted same-objective step, can quantify a finite-model orbital-relaxation mechanism before budgeting full expanded-space MCDHF.

fixed_conditions.nucleus: same native005 Fermi A175 empirical profile
fixed_conditions.Hamiltonian: full declared 531-space Dirac-Coulomb only; no-pair positive nuclear projector fixed to archived original; static Breit not part of orbital EOL gradient
fixed_conditions.ensemble: Equal 1/5 on replay-bound 6s1/2,5d3/2,5d5/2,6p1/2,6p3/2 states; exact J/parity local-root identities from replay target binding
fixed_conditions.physical_tracking: Public CIBasisTracking frozen on actual 531 baseline full eigenvectors and native005 radial basis; re-resolve physical identity on every perturbation and step; majority squared principal overlap >0.5 and unique score boundary, complete degeneracies
fixed_conditions.radial_metric: same saved B-spline S matrices; original005 projectors/inverse blocks retained in004 admissible only under exact complete metric SHA
fixed_conditions.coordinate_recovery: Wide P.T S C recovery; analytic gradient evaluated on actual saved C; all finite coordinate trials use same original linear projector and public polar retraction; actual-vs-reconstructed zero-coordinate energy difference separately reported

procedure.preflight: Verify all frozen source/inputs, complete531 signed basis/counts, full raw M=J and overlap-pair resource counts before angular/radial work
procedure.baseline: Re-solve public full DC CI and compare saved 531 matrix/energies/selected spectral subspaces; evaluate mixed EOL analytic gradient with CI response included through exact eigenstates
procedure.derivative_controls: At most two normalized original-projector tangent directions: negative original-preconditioned gradient and a valence-focused slice reprojected into full tangent. Independent ±h CI re-solves at h=1e-4 and5e-5; compare central slope with analytic constrained derivative and bound trial state/CI gates. No frozen-RDM energy difference substitute.
procedure.one_step: Only after derivative gates, try original-metric preconditioned steepest descent, at most8 halvings from step1, unchanged Armijo1e-4 with actual fully re-solved CI energy; public _polar_retraction reused numerically. Accept one step at most, re-evaluate real mixed gradient and original residual, archive lower/upper DC energy differences separately.
procedure.mixed_difference_API: Record public fixed_density/constrained delta methods explicitly return None on mixed/tracked CI; ordinary re-solved total energies used, no polynomial/trapezoid fallback.
procedure.public_interface_limit: optimize_orbitals has no supplied-original-layout/inverse-metric resume argument; this diagnostic composes unchanged public functional/CI/tracking with archived original metric and existing numerical polar map, and does not call it a full public MCDHF solve.

resources.estimate_basis: prior complete531 DC/static RCI peaked1.22GiB; signed angular tables retained, one radial source gradient streamed; no Hessian/all69 unrestricted magnetic determinant expansion. Actual cap enforcement supersedes estimate.

distinguishing_outcomes: Original-metric residual below original1e-7 and estimatedenergy below1e-8 would support only this declared finite-model numerical EOL stationarity, after derivative/identity controls.
Residual above original gates with validated derivative identifies an orbital-relaxation mechanism not proven by the frozen-RCI spectrum.
A real same-objective accepted step measures absolute lower/upper and transition shifts of this bounded move only; it is neither full relaxed MCDHF nor a strict missing-physics error bound.
Derivative/identity/resource failure stops before acceptance; preserve all failed evidence and identify the public implementation/interface gap without reducing the model or relaxing thresholds.
stopping_condition: One mixed baseline, at most8 central energy re-solves and8 line trials, at most2 real gradients; no complete expanded-space optimization, empirical fit or gate changes. Preserve failed partial evidence.
